params.body:
Closes #992

On the sheet of a sold vehicle the Acties menu still offered a quote, a quote without damage, an order form, an order form without damage and a test drive. A quote went through; an order form opened, could be filled in, and was refused on save because the vehicle is sold. The screen invited an action the platform then refused.

A sold vehicle now gets no Acties menu, on both doors of the sheet (the Livewire host view and the classic header). Bekijken and the back link stay. Copying the vehicle, the one thing still allowed, lives in the list row and is untouched.

The status switches "In optie" and "Klaar voor keuring" were already locked on a sold vehicle, but only their label was dimmed: the switch itself kept its full blue and looked live. The switch now dims with the label.

Not in this change: the quote and order routes themselves still accept a direct call for a sold vehicle; the order form already refuses on save, the quote does not. The business rule that nothing but a copy is allowed on a sold vehicle is now expressed in the sheet, not yet in the quote endpoint.

Tests: `VehicleSheetHeaderTest::test_a_sold_vehicle_shows_bekijken_without_the_menu` renders both doors for a sold vehicle and reads the menu's absence, Bekijken, the back link and the locked switch. It fails on main. Full suite, PHPStan and the compiled views checked locally.
params.title: A sold vehicle's sheet drops the Acties menu and dims its locked switches
